title: New QGIS Canada User Group – Join Us!
content:
The QGIS Canada user group is now official!

Join us for our monthly virtual meetings, held every 3rd Thursday of the month. Our next virtual meeting will be on 15 October, 2026 (but you can also join us through our LinkedIn group, or Discourse discussion channel). Introduce yourself, and discuss plans for our first in-person event. We look forward to hearing from you, to help promote QGIS in Canada!
